probeRecords.observation: At 1023 the setup card stacks and pushes the primary CTA and final summary copy outside the initial viewport, unlike the adjacent 1024 raster.
At 313 effective pixels the two long format labels crowd at the selected-pill boundary and lose immediate target separation.
Terminal content is readable, but the gray page surface and scrollbar visibly end above a large blank white lower region.
No raster visibly presents an independently bounded scrolling component; the only visible scrollbar owns the page viewport.
English strings wrap and remain legible, but the terminal stressed page repeats the premature surface ending and blank lower tail.
The unfinished-session banner, explanation, and continuation CTA are coherent and unobscured after the state transition.
The drawer and scrim own the overlay correctly and restore cleanly, but the small pale close control is visibly under-emphasized for the primary dismissal action.
No raster-visible component exposes a drag handle, reorder target, slider thumb, or other draggable ownership cue; the drawer is presented as tap/click navigation with a close control.
A complete high-contrast purple rectangular ring visibly surrounds the History tab without clipping or covering its label.
The page clears the global header and left navigation rail and remains visually centered among host neighbors.
